create_vae_model: create a QwenImageVAE model with causal 3D convolutions for video encoding and decoding
encode_video_to_latents: encode a batch of video frames into Gaussian latent distributions using the VAE encoder
decode_latents_to_video: decode latent vectors back into video frames using the VAE decoder with causal feature caching
enable_tiled_vae_decode: enable tiled VAE decoding to reduce memory usage for large video dimensions
clear_causal_feature_cache: clear and reset the causal feature cache for encoder and decoder convolutions
